unit_contracts.scope: Only normalized screening values; no physical quantity is inferred.
Requires an explicit measured soil volume and separate pool custody.
Requires positive measured area; runoff and drainage remain separate destination pools.
A retention index never creates nutrient mass.

state_flow_contract.water: Every debit has a named credit among source, surface, soil-mobile, soil-retained, crop, runoff, drainage, atmospheric proxy or external custody pools.
state_flow_contract.nutrients: Fertility and nutrient mass increase only through fertilizer, compost, decomposition, sediment deposition or another named transfer event.
state_flow_contract.organic_matter: Organic matter increases only through a recorded biomass, compost, residue or imported amendment mass transfer.
state_flow_contract.erosion: Topsoil loss becomes sediment, runoff custody or declared external export; it never disappears.
state_flow_contract.contamination: Contaminant mass enters from a named source and leaves only through named removal custody or an explicitly modeled transformation.
state_flow_contract.compaction: Compaction is a response state driven by loading or management; it does not substitute for soil mass or foundation approval.
state_flow_contract.restoration: Restoration requires material, water where used, labor, elapsed time and destination pool credits.
